name: Fossil Group, Inc.
addedReason: premarket mover on a Q3 2026 earnings beat and raised FY2026 revenue outlook

marketCap.note: Based on a $6.53 pre-earnings price; stale versus the current ~$9.97 price

pe.note: Returned to a single quarter of GAAP profit (Q3 2026) after a history of losses; TTM EPS not verified, so trailing P/E not meaningful

growth.note: Revenue roughly flat YoY ($271.2M vs $270.2M); the real story is the swing to GAAP profitability

price.note: No quote newer than 2026-11-12 found this pass; other snapshots found (e.g. ~$7.62-$7.87) are undated/unreliable and not used.

catalysts.headline: Fossil Group management scheduled to present at a Northland Capital Markets investor conference
Fossil Group management presented at the Craig-Hallum Alpha Select Conference
Fossil Group management scheduled to present at the Craig-Hallum Alpha Select Conference
Fossil extended its global brand-ambassador partnership with Nick Jonas through 2027-2028, with two new co-branded Nick Jonas x Fossil watch collections scheduled to debut Fall 2027 and Spring 2028
Fossil Group reported Q3 2026 results described as an earnings beat and raised its full-year 2026 revenue outlook to approximately $990M (up from a prior ~$954-974M range)
catalysts.impact: Premarket move reported between +20.2% and +25.7% across aggregators

catalysts.headline: Q3 2026 results: adjusted EPS of $0.19 vs. analyst estimate of a $0.10 loss; revenue of $271.2M beat forecasts; net profit of $11.7M; company returned to YoY sales growth for the first time in four years; FY2026 outlook raised (CEO: 'year-to-date results are outpacing our expectations')
Announced a five-year extension of its Diesel brand licensing agreement and an extended partnership with Nick Jonas
Fossil Group announced a five-year extension of its global licensing agreement with Diesel, running through 2032, continuing a partnership of more than 25 years

Fossil Group reported Q3 2026 results: net income of $11.7M ($0.19/diluted share, adjusted $0.23) vs a net loss of $39.9M (-$0.76/share) a year earlier; revenue ~$271.2M, beating a ~$247.2M consensus (one other aggregator cites ~$276M — see conflicts); raised full-year 2026 guidance to $980M-$990M in sales and 5.5%-6.5% adjusted operating margin
catalysts.impact: Return to GAAP profitability after a string of losses; ~$10M of wholesale shipments were pulled forward from Q4 into Q3, which flatters the quarter somewhat

catalysts.headline: Fossil Group and Diesel extended their global watch-licensing agreement (reported as a five-year extension running through 2032, continuing a partnership of 25+ years); exact announcement date approximate -- trade coverage dated 2026-11-10 to 2026-11-12
catalysts.impact: Licensing renewal alongside the Q3 2026 earnings beat already on file
catalysts.note: Sources disagree on exact extension length (some say five-year, Japanese-language coverage describes it differently) -- recorded as reported, not reconciled.

catalysts.headline: Fossil Group reported Q3 2026 results after market close; a third-party aggregator (unverified) cites revenue of ~$209.7M (down ~4.9% YoY), gross margin of 62.4% (+490bps), and a net loss of ~$10.6M
catalysts.impact: Low-confidence — the primary press release was not located, and this aggregator's stated year-ago comparison does not match Fossil's own official Q3 2025 release

catalysts.headline: FOSL closed at a 1-year high of $8.06 the session before its Q3 2026 earnings release
catalysts.impact: Stock had rallied into the print; pre-earnings consensus called for a swing to a $0.03 EPS profit on ~$247.2M revenue

conflicts: Q3 2026 revenue: ~$271.2M (consensus-beat reporting) vs ~$276M (MarketBeat); a third source (Panabee) reports a ~$11M net loss, conflicting outright with the company-reported $11.7M net income.
Short interest: Massive.com shows 5.66M shares short as of 2026-09-30 (7.0 days to cover) vs Equibles showing 7.4M shares/12.5% of float/10.9 days to cover as of 2026-10-01.
Market cap/shares outstanding snapshot ($390.31M/59.14M shares, 2026-10-26) predates the Nov 10 earnings pop; treat as stale.
notes: Genuinely quiet this pass: nothing dated after 2026-11-17 (Craig-Hallum conference, already on file) found via WebSearch. The Dec 16 Northland conference remains the only confirmed upcoming date.
